name: pyrevit.export_schedule
description:
Export a Revit schedule to JSON.

Revit Orchestrator tool. The function `run` is the entry point — see
tools/pyrevit/README.md for the full convention.

Inputs (passed as the `inputs` dict):
    schedule_name (str): name of the schedule to export. If omitted, the
        return value lists all available schedules.
    output_path (str, optional): file path to write the JSON to. If omitted,
        the result is returned inline only.

Returns:
    dict with `schedule`, `headers`, `rows`, `row_count`, and (if written)
    `file`. If the requested schedule isn't found, returns a dict with an
    `error` key plus `available_schedules` so the caller can pick a real one.

Detected parameters: uiapp, doc, inputs

arguments.description: Key-value arguments to pass to the script
